chunks: And with this chain, from al-'Amriki ibn al-Bufaki, from one who narrated to him, from Muhammad ibn al-Fadl, from Abu Rabb [Ri'ab], who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the Ziyarah of the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him). He said, 'Yes, it equals an 'Umrah, and it is not fitting that one stay away from it for more than four years.'
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the grave of Imam Husayn and how often should it be done?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* establishes the spiritual equivalence of visiting Imam al-Husayn’s shrine to an 'Umrah, a status that underscores the centrality of the Ahl al-Bayt in Shia devotion. The specific limit of four years serves as a practical jurisprudential guideline to ensure the continuity of this act of worship, preventing it from becoming an occasional or neglected duty.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 10. A group of our companions narrated to me from Aḥmad ibn Idrīs, and from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā Al-‘Aťťār, from ‘Amraki ibn Al-Būfaki, from someone who narrated to him, from Muḥammad ibn Fuďayl, from Abī Rabāb, who said:

I asked Abā ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) about (the reward for) going to the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.). Imam (a.s.) said, “It is equal to performing an ‘Umrah, and one is not permitted to stay away from it for longer than four years.”
